name: perl-time-hires
description: This tool provides high-resolution versions of Perl time functions for microsecond or nanosecond precision. Use when user asks to measure execution time, implement sub-second delays, or set fractional timeouts in Perl scripts.
overview: `perl-time-hires` provides the `Time::HiRes` module, which implements high-resolution versions of standard Perl time functions. While standard Perl typically operates with one-second resolution, this module allows for microsecond or even nanosecond precision. It is the industry standard for performance profiling, precise delays in automation, and handling sub-second timeouts in network or hardware interfacing scripts.
